name: Two-agent hand-off
description: One agent does a first piece of work, a second agent takes the first one's answer and does the next piece, and the result is sent to an agent of yours as a message. Use it to split a job where the second step needs the first one's findings, such as research then a summary. Run it by hand; add a schedule in the Jobs tab if you want one.

first.title: First agent's work
first.description: What the first agent does, such as: List the open pull requests of acme/site older than a week.

second.title: Second agent's work
second.description: What the second agent does with the first one's answer, such as: Write a two-line status for each pull request.

owner.title: Who to tell
owner.description: The id of the agent that gets the result as a message.
